reference: 1986, T.B. Massalski, J.L. Murray, L.H. Bennet, H. Baker, in: T.B. Massalski (Ed.), Binary Alloy Phase Diagrams, American Society for Metals, Metals Park, OH, 1986.
comment: ORCHID literature values, Version 1, machine-extracted. Evidence class: experimental. ORCHID observation ids (orchid-literature `id`, one per value, in value order): ORC-WGMFDCVXWT

values.sigma_basis: zpf (ESPEI weighs ZPF data by a driving-force tolerance, not a value sigma; no weight set)

orchid_uncertainty.weight_rule: none: ZPF scale is ESPEI's driving-force tolerance; weight left at 1 (the temperature and composition budgets are information for the user)

orchid_zpf_encoding.rule: E2: vertices of phases that are stoichiometric in the target TDB are written with composition null (ESPEI evaluates a line compound at its own formula composition; a fixed composition gives NaN in ESPEI 0.9.1 / pycalphad 0.11.2); the printed composition stays in the literature release (orchid.observations ids)
